title: Percy Jackson and the Sea of Monsters
author: Rick Riordan
summary: The second Percy Jackson book. When the magic that protects a summer camp for young demigods begins to fail, Percy and his friends set out across the sea on a quest that has dangers from Greek myth around every corner.
readIf: you like quick, funny adventure with Greek mythology and an easy-to-love hero.
skipIf: you have not read The Lightning Thief, since this one builds on its characters and events.

pairings.reason: The first book, where Percy discovers who he is and meets the characters again here.
Another middle-grade adventure with a magical place full of creatures and a family secret.
The second book in another popular series, with a similar mix of mystery, school and monsters.
